name: openbb_regulators_sec_filings
description:
Meant to list SEC filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K) for one company through OpenBB (obb.regulators.sec.filings).
Returns: {tool, data_points (total rows), data: first 100 rows as OpenBB returns them} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): symbol*; provider (schema default sec; when omitted the tool sends yfinance).
OpenBB 4.x (4.6 checked) has no obb.regulators.sec.filings, so this tool currently returns an error object; alternatives: edgar_company_submissions, edgar_filings_by_form, sec_get_company_filings or fmp_sec_filings.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL", "provider": "sec"}
